contract.title: Threat Hunter Hunts Empty-State Foundation
prohibited_actions: Do not modify backend or domain contracts
Do not modify routing or workspace navigation
Do not introduce fake hunts or synthetic product data
Do not modify AIDP orchestration implementation
acceptance_criteria: The Hunts area at /threat-hunting/hunts presents a clear empty state when no hunts are available.
The empty state must not fabricate hunts counts findings statuses or other synthetic security data.
Existing Threat Hunter navigation and URL-authoritative behavior remain unchanged.
The implementation is limited to the authorized Threat Hunter frontend scope.
Automated frontend coverage verifies the Hunts empty-state behavior.
All required validations pass before the task is published for Architect review.
